panels.description: Shows current active MongoDB connections, rejected connection,available connection capacity.
panels.title: MongoDB Connection Usage & Capacity

panels.description: Tells how many documents or records are stored in the database.
panels.title: Total Objects (Documents)

panels.description: Shows the total number of collections present in each MongoDB database.
panels.title: MongoDB Total Collections

panels.description: Displays the total number of documents in each MongoDB database to track data growth and detect abnormal insert patterns.
panels.title: Mongo db Data Size

panels.description: Displays the rate of MongoDB database operations per second, including command, query, insert, update, and delete operations.
panels.title: Total Operations

panels.description: This graph specifically tracks the rate of document-level operations (inserts, queries, updates, deletes, getsmore, commands). This helps understand the intensity of CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) activity.
panels.title: Document Operations

panels.description:
Shows how much data is coming into the database.
This includes requests, queries, etc.
panels.title: Network Inbound Traffic

panels.description: Shows how much data the database is sending out, like responses.
panels.title: Network Outbound Traffic

panels.description: Displays how many total requests are hitting the database.
panels.title: Network Requests

panels.description: Displays the number of open cursors in MongoDB. High values may indicate long-running queries or inefficient data retrieval.
panels.title: Active Cursors

panels.description: Displays the number of page requests made to the WiredTiger cache. These requests represent attempts by MongoDB to retrieve data from memory before accessing disk storage.
panels.title: Cache Requested

panels.description: Shows the rate of pages read from disk into the WiredTiger cache, indicating cache misses and disk access frequency.
panels.title: Cache Hit Ratio

panels.description: Shows how much space is used by indexes.
panels.title: Total Index Size

panels.description: This panel shows the total number of indexes defined across all collections in all databases.
panels.title: Total Indexes

panels.description: Displays the number of read and write operations currently waiting for database locks. High values may indicate lock contention or heavy workload.
panels.title: MongoDB Lock Queue

panels.description: Amount of physical RAM currently used by the MongoDB process
panels.title: Resident Memory

panels.description: Total virtual memory allocated by MongoDB
panels.title: Virtual Memory
